as_told.title: The curse of King Tut's tomb: the excavators die or meet tragedy
as_told.place_text: Tutankhamun's tomb, Valley of the Kings, Egypt

plain: The tomb of the Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun is said to carry a curse on those who disturbed it. Michels brings it up himself, without naming a source, saying a couple of people tried to x-ray it and then "sort of die mysteriously." Luke Caverns, a researcher of ancient Egypt, tells it in more detail: "almost every person" on the excavation led by the archaeologist Howard Carter "had something tragic happen to them," and several died from poisoning after breathing the air inside the chamber. In his telling the curse would have a physical cause rather than a supernatural one.
